immutability.note: Compare against the sha256 recorded when the first labelling call ran. A mismatch means the preregistration or the runner was edited after data collection began and the run is not preregistered.

prediction.MULTIPLICITY_CLAUSE: board_acc is the single preregistered primary statistic. The 36-cell transition matrix, per-class marginals and NMI are descriptive. NO INDIVIDUAL TRANSITION CELL MAY BE REPORTED AS A RESULT (e.g. 'B1->B3 runs at 3x chance' is forbidden) -- that is the forking path this clause closes.

C1_surface_turnN_text.recipe: acceptance_gate recipes (char TF-IDF(3,5) max_features=5000; CountVectorizer(3000, stop_words=english, binary); length) + LogisticRegression(max_iter=500, random_state=42), C tuned on grouped inner splits of the training fold only, LOCO outer folds
C1_surface_turnN_text.kill_rule: surface = max(char, word, length); if surface_acc >= board_acc the board abstraction adds nothing

C2_marginal_mode.note: Gate 0 permits the 'none' class up to 0.40 of consensus labels, so an always-predict-mode rule can score up to ~0.40 = 2.4x the 1/6 label chance the console prints. 1/6 is NOT the relevant baseline; this LOCO-measured marginal is.

C3_permutation_null.why: a global permutation also destroys conversation-level clustering, so label homogeneity within a conversation alone would push board_acc above the null and pass this gate with no transition structure

C5_user_followup_only.sampling: follow-ups drawn i.i.d. WITH REPLACEMENT, one independent draw per (conversation, turn), so f_t is independent of f_{t+1}

C6_persistence_bN.note: computed over the same LOCO test indices; no fitted parameters, so the value is fold-invariant

controls.diagnostic_same_turn_ungrouped_caveat: acceptance_gate.gate_surface_separability uses StratifiedKFold with no conversation grouping, so same-conversation text leaks across folds and inflates it; it also silently returns {'error': ...} when any class has fewer than 5 members. Its `chance` argument is accepted but NEVER USED in its body -- passing chance=1/6 configures nothing. Reported for comparability only; the LOCO-grouped numbers above are what flags.

uncertainty.method: paired cluster bootstrap over conversations, 300 resamples, seed 7; gating margins require BOTH the point margin and a 5th-percentile lower bound above 0
uncertainty.power_note: 63 pairs over 20 conversations fill a 6x6 = 36-cell transition table (~1.8 observations per cell), and observations cluster within conversations, so effective n is well below the pair count. A failed GATE 2 at this n may reflect power, not truth; that is why the bootstrap bound, not the point estimate alone, is preregistered.

THE BOARD-TO-BOARD SEQUENCING CLAIM IS OURS, NOT THE BOOK'S. The CAS-PCBA book specifies intra-board stage sequencing richly and inter-board sequencing not at all (zero hits for backplane / board-to-board / inter-board / 'the next board'); its only stated board-to-board relation is a power-supply dependency (CPMB).

WHAT A GATE 1 PASS ACTUALLY LICENSES. b_N is a 3-model LLM consensus reading and the surface control is a TF-IDF/count logistic regression. Beating it licenses 'an LLM ensemble reading of turn N beats surface models of turn N', not 'the board abstraction carries information'. Only GATE 8 (matched discourse taxonomy, same panel, same corpus) speaks to whether the BOARD taxonomy specifically matters, and one matched control is not the space of taxonomies.
DESIGN VALUES, NOT MEASUREMENTS. Every board parameter in the source is an author's design choice; the rubric judges observable text behaviour only.

RATING RUBRIC, NOT PHYSICS. A pass licenses only that this annotation is reliable and carries sequential information beyond surface text, marginals, a within-conversation permutation null, the scripted user move and turn position, within one corpus read by four related commercial models. No product-ACCEPT, no human-cognition, no cross-model-universality claim.
A VACUOUS verdict means the prediction numbers in this file are NOT evidence and may not be cited.
